answer: Because the ocean pair is tracked in the mesa ledger, the vertex audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 196 identities means 196 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 32%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
